mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening by the Fed, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent Fed tightening actions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the labor growth signal, or PAYEMS MoM > 300k does not correlate with subsequent earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the demand contraction signal, or RSAFS MoM < -1% does not correlate with subsequent revenue declines.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% MoM signals strengthening supply-side activity, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the supply growth signal, or INDPRO MoM > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5% YoY and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the same period, it signals a tightening labor market, which boosts wage inflation and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market tightening signal, or the combined signal does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline by more than 0.5% MoM, it signals a weakening demand environment, which negatively impacts corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the demand contraction signal, or the combined signal does not correlate with subsequent revenue declines.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in 3 months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal, or FEDFUNDS 3M > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent restrictive monetary policy effects.
